title: Jordan of Skywatchers shown a sphere in the GATE program

tellings.quote: When he was involved in the gate program as a late teen, uh, intelligence or military brass and and suits and, you know, eggghheads brought in a case, opened it up, and there was the same exact sphere.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose, connected to a group called Skywatchers, is said to have been taken into something called the GATE program as a late teenager, where military officers, intelligence people and scientists brought in a case, opened it, and showed him a sphere exactly like one seen elsewhere. The researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb tells this as something Jose told him, and it would mean officials have long held such spheres and shown them to chosen young people.
